target: repair/ candidate plus original/ baseline and preserved case
requested_decision: Does the exact committed repaired candidate satisfy the scoped contract and repair acceptance gates?
scope: Both functions and supplied tests against CONTRACT.md; no concurrency, persistence, performance, or external services. Initial role assignment only.
budget: At most 10 minutes; bounded complete repair check, no unrelated investigation.
authorized_actions: Read original case, testimony, errata, repair plan, candidate, full diff and validation. Write REPAIR_CHECK.md and necessary bounded probes in roles/repair_checker only. No repairs, source edits, commits, publication or delegation.
authorized_tools: Local file reads and assigned writes. Necessary reviewed small Python probes must use capture.py --role repair_checker.
execution: Known small pure-Python fixture; inspect before executing. Probes must use capture.py, <=20s each, <=64KiB stdout and stderr, <=1MiB scratch per role. No Docker/build/cache. Network restriction is instruction-only; filesystem and credentials are not sandboxed.
capabilities: Fresh independent context and local file tools available; same Watson context can be recalled. Shared model/host can correlate errors.
separation: New checker context with no prior participation or repair authorship. Original case and changed evidence supplied for reassessment. Do not read evaluator/ or other conversations. Shared host, instruction-only access restrictions.
acceptance_criteria: CONTRACT.md is authoritative; report established violations and uncertainties. No finding quota. All source must remain unchanged.
author_overlap: Coordinator authored the synthetic fixture and this repair. This fresh checker did not author either or participate in previous phases.
